verdict.rationale: Auth0's own log streaming service exports tenant events in near real-time, and you can pick the content type and format and preview the payload. That points to an outbound event-delivery mechanism a programmatic consumer could subscribe to. However, the evidence never says these are registrable HTTP webhook endpoints, and it frames the feature as export to log analysis services. missing for 10: explicit documentation of registrable HTTP webhook endpoints, a catalog of subscribable event types, delivery/retry and signature verification details, and independent or hands-on corroboration.
